Package io.github.jabrena.juno.api

package io.github.jabrena.juno.api
The Java-facing hardware API that Juno's compiler recognizes as intrinsics.

Every operation here is declared as ordinary Java — a native method, or a plain static method built only from other supported operations — so a program using this API still compiles and reads like normal Java. At link time, Juno's linker/backend recognize the native methods (see IntrinsicRegistry) and emit their Arduino C++/assembly implementation directly, instead of requiring a JVM to interpret them. There is no runtime reflection, dependency injection, or driver discovery: the mapping from a Java call to generated hardware code is fixed and closed-world.

This package holds simple, cross-cutting operations directly:

  • Delay — blocking millisecond/microsecond delays.
  • Clock — the monotonic uptime clock, for measuring elapsed time without blocking.

Board-specific or peripheral-specific operations live in subpackages instead, grouped by the hardware they address:

  • io — general-purpose I/O (Gpio, DigitalOutput), USB serial (io.usb), USB HID mouse control (io.hid), and the Wi-Fi/HTTP/JSON networking stack (io.net).
  • led — the UNO R4 WiFi's built-in LED matrix, its frame/canvas helpers, and bitmap fonts.
  • lcd — drivers for character LCD shields, built entirely from io and Delay rather than a new compiler intrinsic.

Classes in this package and its subpackages are final, non-instantiable utility types (or, for a handle like DigitalOutput, a zero-cost wrapper around a primitive pin number) with no shared mutable state of their own: Juno has no heap for general object graphs, so the API is deliberately kept close to the primitive operations the generated firmware actually performs.

An entry-point class selects its compilation target with a @Board annotation and then calls into this API from main; see the project README.md and docs/ for narrative guides to individual areas (Serial, the LCD Keypad Shield, HID, Clock, and Internet access).

    Package
    Description
    io.github.jabrena.juno
    Juno's top-level compiler entry points: the CLI, the embeddable compiler API, and the small value types that connect them.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io
    General-purpose digital/analog I/O: Gpio, the raw pin-number operations (pinMode/digitalWrite/digitalRead/ analogRead/analogWrite/toggle), and DigitalOutput, a zero-cost handle bound to one output pin (high/low/toggle/isHigh) for callers that prefer an object-shaped API over passing a pin number to every call.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.lcd
    Drivers for character LCD shields, currently LcdKeypadShield: a 16x2 HD44780-compatible display in 4-bit mode plus 5 buttons read from a single resistor-ladder analog pin, wired for the shield's standard pinout.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.led
    The UNO R4 WiFi's built-in 12x8 LED matrix: LedMatrix, the raw compiler-intrinsic begin/loadFrame/clear operations, and LedCanvas, a boolean[HEIGHT][WIDTH] pixel buffer with shape and text drawing helpers that render into it and send it to the hardware with show.
